KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT.title: Kakarot
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT.description: Born a Saiyan, raised on Earth, always looking for a stronger opponent. Build Rage by taking hits or playing Strike cards, then spend Rage through card and relic effects.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT.cardsModifierDescript: Kakarot cards can appear in rewards and shops.
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT.banter.dead.endTurnPi: Don't give up! I'll be right back!
KAKAROTMOD-KAKAROT.goldMonologue: Someone stronger is out there. I can feel it!
